tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya pradzñā pa ra mi tā sañtsa ya gā thā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor bzhi po de dag la yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ston cing*/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' bstsal to// dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer bzhag ste// sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal nas dri ma las 'das pa// 'gro don mngon zhugs des pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin// gang la dpa' rnams spyod pa de ni mnyan par gyis// 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing*// me tog 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal skyed byed pa// ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag rten gnas te// de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin// rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang*// 'chad dang rigs pa dag dang bden par brjod pa dang*// mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa// de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu'i mthu// ci phyir zhe na rgyal bas chos tshul gang bstan pa// de la mi mchog slob mar gyur pas mngon bslabs shing*// mngon sum byas nas bslabs pa ji bzhin ston byed de// sangs rgyas mthus byed rang gi stobs kyi mthus ma yin// gang la shes rab pha rol phyin mchog mi dmigs shing*/ byang chub sems dpa' mi dmigs byang chub sems mi dmigs// de skad thos nas rmongs pa med cing mi skrag pa// byang chub sems dpa' de ni bde gshegs shes rab spyod// gzugs med tshor ba med cing 'du shes sems pa med// de la rnam shes gnas ni rdul tsam yod pa min// de chos kun la mi gnas gnas pa med par spyod/ yongs su gzung med bde gshegs rnams kyi byang chub 'thob// ji ltar kun tu rgyu ba phreng can shes pa yis// dmigs med phung po rnam par 'jig pa 'byung ba ltar// byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de ltar chos shes pa// mya ngan 'das la mi reg de ni shes rab gnas// yang 'di shes rab 'di ni gang yin su yi yin// gang las yin zhes chos 'di thams cad stong par rtogs// nye bar btags nas zhum pa med cing skrag med pa// byang chub sems dpa' de ni byang chub nye ba yin// gal te mi shes bzhin du gzugs su 'du shes shing*// tshor ba sems pa rnam shes phung po spyod byed na// phung 'di stong zhes rtogs na 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' ni// mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin// gang zhig gzugs min tshor min 'du shes sems dpa' ni// rnam par shes la mi spyod gnas pa med par spyod// de ni spyod ces bya bar mi dmigs shes rab brtan// skye med blo ldan ting 'dzin zhi ba mchog la reg

/byang chub sems gang de ltar 'dir bdag zhir gnas pa// de ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan yin// bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am langs zhes rlom sems med// ci phyir zhe na chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes phyir// de ltar spyod na bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyod// des ni spyod med spyod pa yin par rab shes phyir// chos gang spyod pa de yang dmigs par mi gyur te// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// gang zhig yod pa ma yin de ni med ces bya// byis pa rnams kyis der brtags yod dang med par byed// yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te// byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung*// gang 'dir phung po lnga dag sgyu ma 'drar shes shing*// sgyu ma gzhan dang phung po gzhan du mi byed la// sna tshogs 'du shes bral zhing nye bar zhi spyod pa// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// dge ba'i bshes dang ldan zhing lhag mthong ldan gyur pa// rgyal ba rnams kyi yum thos skrag par yod mi 'gyur// gang zhig sdig pa'i grogs ldan gzhan gyi dring 'jog pa// de ni snod so ma btang chus reg zhig pa bzhin// ci phyir 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' bya zhe na// chags pa gcod byed kun la chags pa byed par 'dod// rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub chags med gyur la reg /des na 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ming thob bo// de phyir de ni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na// sems can tshogs ldan mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa dang*// sems can khams kyi lta rnams chen po gcod pa ste// de phyir sems dpa' chen po zhes ni rab brjod do// gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu che dang*// rgyal ba rnams kyi theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang*// go cha chen po bgos shing bdud kyi sgyu 'dul ba// de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes rab tu brjod// dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis bzhi mdor sprul byas te// skye bo phal cher mgo mang bye ba gcod byed pa'i// bsad bya de dag ci 'dra de ltar byang chub sems// 'gro kun sprul 'drar rab shes de la 'jigs pa med// gzugs dang 'du shes tshor ba dang ni sems pa dang*// rnam par shes pa ma bcings ma grol yod pa min// de ltar byang chub la 'jug zhum pa'i sems med pa// 'di ni gang zag dam pa rnams kyi go cha mchog

/ci phyir 'di ni byang chub theg chen bya zhe na// de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan 'da'// theg pa 'di ni mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang chen te// dga' skyid bde ba mngon par thob byed theg pa'i mchog /gang zhig zhon nas phyogs su 'gro ba dmigs su med// mya ngan 'das par 'gro bar gsungs pa 'gro mi dmigs// dper na mi shi de yi 'gro rgyu med pa bzhin// rgyu des nas ni mya ngan 'das zhes rab tu brjod// byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi mtha' dang*// da ltar byung bar mi dmigs dus gsum dag pa ste// gang dag de ni 'dus ma byas yin spros med de// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// byang chub sems mkhas rig pa gang gi dus kyi tsho// skye med rnam par bsams te 'di ltar spyod byed cing*// snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// gal te sems can 'du shes sdug bsngal 'du shes skyed// 'gro ba rnams kyi don bya sdug bsngal spang snyam ste// bdag dang sems can yongs rtogs byang chub sems dpa' de// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod ma yin// bdag ci 'dra ba de 'drar sems can thams cad shes// sems can thams cad ci 'dra de 'dra chos kun shes// skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis gar mi rtog pa// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// 'jig rten dag ni chos ming ji snyed yongs brjod pa// kun la skye ba dang ni yang dag 'bras spangs nas// ye shes 'chi med dam pa de las gzhal med thob// de phyir 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin ces bya// byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig dogs med de ltar spyod// shes rab ldan de mnyam nyid gnas par shes par bya// chos rnams rang bzhin med par yongs su shes gyur pa// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// skabs dang po'o/// /gang zhig gzugs la mi gnas tshor la mi gnas shing*// gang zhig 'du shes mi gnas sems par mi gnas la// rnam shes gang mi gnas pa chos nyid gnas pa ste// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// rtag dang mi rtag bde dang sdug bsngal sdug mi sdug

/bdag dang bdag med de bzhin nyid dang de bzhin stong*// 'bras bu thob dang dgra bcom sa la mi gnas shing*// rang rgyal sa dang de bzhin sangs rgyas sar mi gnas// ji ltar 'dren pa 'dus ma byas khams mi gnas shing*// de bzhin 'dus byas la yang mi gnas gnas med spyod// de ltar byang chub sems dpa' gnas la gnas med gnas// gnas med gnas yin 'di ni rgyal bas gnas par gsungs// gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang*// rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin ches rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa// bzod pa 'di la ma brten thob par mi nus te// dper na pha rol tshul rol 'gro ngogs mi mthong bzhin// chos 'chad pa dang nyan dang bshad bya gang yin dang*// 'bras bu thob dang rkyen rgyal de bzhin 'jig rten mgon/ mkhas pa gsal bas thob pa'i mya ngan 'das gang yin// de kun sgyu ma lta bur de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// gang zag bzhi po 'di dag de la mi skrag ste// rgyal sras bden la mkhas dang phyir mi ldog pa dang*// dgra bcom dri ma bsal zhing som nyi spangs pa dang*// bzhi pa dge ba'i bshes kyis yongs su zin pa'o// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rig de ltar spyod pa ni// dgra bcom sa la mi slob rkyen rtog sa la min// thams cad mkhyen nyid ched du sangs rgyas chos rjes slob// gang zhig slob mi slob la mi slob de slob yin// gzugs 'phel yongs su nyams dang yongs su gzung phyir min// chos rnams sna tshogs yongs su gzung phyir mi slob par// slob cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang yongs zin la// nges byung gang yin 'di ni yon tan dga' bas slob// gzugs ni shes rab ma yin gzugs la shes rab med// rnam shes 'du shes tshor dang sems dpa' 'di dag ni// shes rab ma yin 'di dag la yang shes rab med// 'di ni nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs te tha dad med// dmigs pa rnams kyi rang bzhin de ni pha mtha' med// sems can rang bzhin gang yin de yang pha mtha' med// nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin de yang pha mtha' med// 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i shes rab de yang pha mtha' med// 'du shes tshu rol yin zhes 'dren pas yongs su bsgrags// 'du shes rnam par bshigs nas spong ba pha rol 'gro// gang dag 'du shes bral ba 'di ni rjes thob pa/

de dag pha rol phyin nas ston pa'i bka' la gnas// gal te ston pas kyang ni gaṅga'i ji snyed kyi// bskal par bzhugs te sems can zhes sgra yongs bsgrags kyang*// gzod nas dag pas sems can skye bar ga la 'gyur// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// gang tshe nga ni pha rol phyin pa'i mchog 'di dang*// mthun par smra gyur de tshe sngon gyi skyes mchog gis// ma 'ongs pa yi dus nas sangs rgyas 'gyur ro zhes// nga lung bstan par gyur ces rgyal bas de skad gsung*// shes rab pha rol phyin pa gang la mgon spyod pa// 'di ni gang zhig gus byas 'dzin dang chub byed pa// de la dug dang mtshon dang me dang chus mi tshugs// bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs kyis glags kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi// mchod rten rin chen bdun las byas shing mchod byed la// bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag gang ga yi// bye ma snyed kyis bye ba phrag stong zhing bkang ste// yongs su rtag bzung zhing rnams bye ba mtha' yas na// sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyis// las gzhan mi byed lha yi me tog spos rab dang*// byugs pas dus gsum bskal pa'ang de bas lhag mchod la// gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung gyur pa// bde bar gshegs kyi yum 'di glegs bam la bris te// 'chang zhing me tog byugs pas bsti stang byed gyur na// mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod// rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di rig sngags che// sems can khams mang mya ngan sdug bsngal chos zhi byed// gang dag 'das dang gang du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon// rig sngags 'di bslabs sman pa'i rgyal po bla med 'gyur// gang dag phan dang snying brtser bcas par spyad spyod pa// rig sngags 'di la bslabs nas mkhas pa byang chub reg

/'dus byas bde dang 'dus ma byas bde gang yin pa// bde ba de kun 'di las byung bar rig par bya// sa bon btab nas sa la gnas te 'byung 'gyur ba// tshogs pa rnyed nas rnam mang gzugs dag rnam par skye// pha rol phyin lnga byang chub yon tan ji snyed pa// de dag kun kyang shes rab pha rol phyin las skye// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal lam gang nas ni rtag 'gro ba// lam de nyid nas rin chen bdun dang dpung tshogs kun// gang nas rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di 'gro// de nyid nas ni yon tan chos kun 'gro bar 'gyur// rgyal bas brgya byin dri ba yongs dris lan gsol pa// gal te gang gā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing gyur pa// de kun rgyal ba'i ring srel byur bur gtams gyur kyang*// bdag ni shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di nyid len// ci slad ce na sku gdung mi gus bdag ma lags// 'on kyang shes rab yongs su bsgom pas mchod par bgyi// dper na rgyal po brten mi rim gro thob pa ltar// sangs rgyas ring srel shes rab pha rol phyin la brten// nor bu rin chen yon tan kun ldan rin thang med// gab tshe gang du stsal ba de ni phyag bgyi 'os// de phyung gyur kyang gab tsho la ni dga' bgyid de// yon tan de dag nor bu rin chen de yi lags// de bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin mchog yon tan gyis// rgyal ba mya ngan 'das kyang ring srel mchod pa brnyes// de ltas gang zhig rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dzin 'tshal nges// shes rab pha rol phyin blang 'di ni thar pa lags// sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste// tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no// dge chos chud mi son phyir yongs su 'dzin pa yin// 'di ni chos rnams thams cad tshul gcig ston par byed// dper na 'dzam bu'i gling na shing rnams bye ba stong*// rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa du ma gzugs mang ba// grib mar gyur pa'i grangs su brjod pa ma gtogs par// grib ma sna tshogs med cing bye brag yod ma yin// de bzhin rgyal ba'i pha rol phyin lnga 'di dag kyang*// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i ming nyid thob par 'gyur// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phyir yongs su bsngos byas ni// byang chub ces bya drug po 'di kun ro gcig 'gyur// byang chub sems dpa' gal te rab tu mi shes bzhin// gzugs dang 'du shes tshor dang sems pa rnam par shes// mi rtag yongs su ston pa bcos la spyod pa ste// mkhas pa nam yang chos rnams 'jig par mi byed do// gang la gzugs min tshor min 'du shes mi dmigs shing*// rnam par shes pa ma yin sems pa mi dmigs la// chos kun skye med stong pa'i tshul du rab shes pa// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// la las gaṅga'i klung gi ji snyed zhing rnams na// sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas// gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te// sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags// ci phyir zhe na smra mchog de dag 'dir bslabs nas// chos rnams mtha' dag stong pa nyid du 'dir ston byed// de thos nyan thos myur du rnam par grol la reg

/rang rgyal byang chub dang ni sangs rgyas byang chub reg /myu gu med par 'jig rten sdong 'byung yod med na// de la yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu ga la 'byung*// byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang tshe 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed// de tshe sems can las byed brtson pa de bzhin du// mkhas pa shes phyir 'jig rten byang chub sems byung na// ye shes kyis ni sems can yon tan chos dang ldan// dper na ma dros mtsho la klu bdag med gyur na// 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung 'bab par ga la 'gyur// chu klung med na me tog 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur// rgya mtsho la yang rin chen gzugs mang med par 'gyur// de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi// ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun tu ga la 'byung*// ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med// rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur// 'jig rten 'di na snang byed srog chags ji snyed pa// kun gyis snang bar bya phyir 'od rnams phyung ba bas// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gcig phyung ches mchog ste// snang byed tshogs kyi 'od rnams kun gyis char mi phod// nyan thos tshogs rnams ji snyed sbyin dang tshul khrims dang*// sgom dang rab tu ldan pa'i bsod nams tshogs bskyed pa'ang*// byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi rang sems gcig la// nyan thos tshogs kyi bsod nams phung pos char mi phod// 'das dus sngon gyis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang*// zhing mang mtha' yas bye stong dag na gang bzhugs dang*// gang yang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams// sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir rin chen chos ston pa// dang po byang chub mchog tu sems skyed bskyed pa nas// rnam par 'dren pa rnams kyi dam chos zad kyi dus// de bas rgyal ba de dag bsod nams gang yin pa// pha rol phyin dang ldan dang sangs rgyas chos gang dang*// gang yang sangs rgyas sras rnams dang ni nyan thos dang*// slob dang mi slob dge ba zag bcas zag med pa// bsdus nas byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi rang zhing*// 'gro ba'i don rgyu byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo// yongs bsngo gal te sems su 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing*// byang chub 'du shes yongs bsngo sems can 'du shes na// 'du shes phyir na lta gnas sems ni gsum la chags// dmigs pa yod pas yongs su bsngos par chud ma yin// gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang*// gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang*// chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na// de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin// gal te mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo ma yin// ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin// ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba// dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyas bas gsungs// de ltas 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ba bslab bya ste// ji ltar rgyal ba de dag dge ba de mkhyen pa'i// rnam pa gang yin 'byung gang mtshan nyid gang yin la// rjes su yi rang de lta de ltar yongs su bsngo// de ltar bsod nams byang chub yongs su sngo byed na// dug med sangs rgyas mi spong rgyal bas gsungs pa smra// de ltar yongs bsngo dpa' bo 'jig rten dmigs can gyis// byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed thams cad zil gyis gnon// dmus long dmigs bu med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams// lam yang mi shes grong khyer 'jug par ga la 'gyur// shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'di// dmigs bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin// gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur pa// de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob bo// dper na ri mo'i las ni yongs zin mig med pa// ji srid mig ma bris par brngan pa mi thob bzhin// gang tsho 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos// shes rab rnam par bshig nas rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe// 'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rol phyin grangs 'gro// nam mkha' gang la'ang cung zad mi gnas de dang 'dra// gal te bdag ni rgyal ba'i shes rab spyad bya zhing*// sems can sdug bsngal reg pa khrag khrig mang dgrol sems// sems can 'du shes yongs rtog byang chub sems dpa' de// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod ma yin/

byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig mngon par spyod pa'i tshe// pha rol phyin 'dir spyad pa mkhas pa som nyi med// thos ma thag tu de yi ston pa'i 'du shes skyed// des ni byang chub zhi ba myur du rtogs par 'gyur// sngon spyod tshe na sangs rgyas khrag khrig bkur bas kyang*// rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin la ma dad na// thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed pa// spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro// de lta bas na gal te sangs rgyas ye shes mchog /reg par 'dod na rgyal ba'i yum 'dir dad par gyis// dper na tshong pa rin chen gling du song nas ni// zong zad slar log lta bur gyur na mi rung ngo*// gzugs kyi dag pa 'bras bu dag par rig par bya// 'bras bu gzugs dag thams cad mkhyen nyid dag par 'gyur// thams cad mkhyen nyid 'bras bu dag par gzugs dag pa// nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs te dbyer med bcad du med// skabs gnyis pa'o/// /dpa' bo gar spyod shes rab pha rol phyin pa yas// khams gsum yang dag 'das la rnam par grol ba'ang min// nyon mongs bsal bar gyur kyang skye ba ston par byed// rga dang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston// 'gro ba 'di dag ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags// rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyams/ 'gro ba 'khrul pa ri dwags rgyar tshud 'drar shes nas// shes rab ldan pa mkha' la bya bzhin rnam par rgyu// spyod pa yang dag gang zhig gzugs la mi spyod cing*// rnam shes 'du shes tshor ba sems par mi spyod na// de ltar spyod pa chags pa thams cad yongs spong zhing*// chags las rnam grol bde gshegs rnams kyi shes par spyod// de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mkhas gsal ba// chags pa bcad nas grol la chags pa med par 'gro// nyi ma sgra gcan gza' bral lhang nger 'dug pa dang*// me btang rtsa dang shing dang nags tshal sreg pa bzhin// chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin dag cing yongs dag par// byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin lta na// byed pa po yang mi dmigs chos kun mi dmigs te// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// skabs gsum pa'o/// /rgyal ba de ni lha rgyal brgya byin gyis zhus pa// byang chub sems dpa' shes rab spyod pa ji ltar brtson// phung po khams la rdul tsam brtson par mi byed cing*// phung por mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpa'i brtson// gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar thos nas// som nyi med cing slob la phyir zhing sbyor byed pa// sems can de ni ring nas theg chen zhugs rig pa// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang la lhag byas yin// dgon pa'i lam ni dpag tshad mang po zhugs pa'i mis// gnag rdzi mtshams kyi nags tshal phun sum tshogs mthong na// 'di dag grong dang grong khyer nye ba'i rtags snyam ste// dbugs phyin rnyed par gyur cing chom rkun 'jigs pa med// de bzhin byang chub yongs su 'tshol tshe rgyal rnams kyi// shes rab pha rol phyin 'di mnyan par gang thob pa// de ni dbugs phyin thob par gyur cing 'jigs med de// dgra 'gyur// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag yongs su 'dzin la sbyor// ma zhig na bar gyur la bu ni mang yod pa// de kun yid mi bde zhing de la rim gro byed// de bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi par// ri dwags phra mo mang skrag byed cing sgra sgrog ltar// mi yi seng ge shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas// mu stegs can mang skrag phyir 'jig rten sgra yang sgrog /dper na nam mkhar gnas pa'i nyi
